title: SE-BRL Independent Behavioral Annotation Guide

annotation_states.supported: Required evidence is assessable and qualifying evidence is observed.
annotation_states.absent: Required evidence is assessable but qualifying evidence is not observed.
annotation_states.unavailable: The modality or required field prevents assessment.

rules: Annotate observable behavior, not the attack-category label.
Do not infer malicious intent solely from suspicious keywords.
Mark unavailable when required evidence cannot be assessed.
Use available text for linguistic cues; do not invent sender, brand, or visual evidence.
Record supporting text spans for supported indicators.
Do not use model predictions when assigning human labels.
Annotators work independently before disagreements are resolved.

dimensions.name: Requested Action and Consequence
qualifying_boundary: Requests to click, reply, download, visit, or submit data
exclusions: Verified transaction notices without a requested action

modality_constraints.name: Content-Bearing Email
modality_constraints.required_evidence_rule: Content-dependent dimensions are assessable only when required email content exists; trust and identity manipulation additionally requires identity/brand fields or visual/structural evidence.

modality_constraints.name: Content-Bearing Webpage
modality_constraints.required_evidence_rule: Content-dependent dimensions are assessable only when required webpage content exists; trust and identity manipulation additionally requires identity/brand fields or visual/structural evidence.

modality_constraints.name: Stand-Alone URL
modality_constraints.required_evidence_rule: A bare URL does not permit assessment of content-dependent behavioral dimensions.

modality_constraints.name: Engineered Technical Record
modality_constraints.required_evidence_rule: Engineered technical records remain technical-only. If qualifying email or webpage content exists, future routing must classify the artifact as content-bearing rather than as an engineered technical record.

support_codes.definition: Assessable only with required identity/brand fields or visual/structural evidence.
Unavailable from bare URLs or technical-only records.
